messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
allah mun tuba allah idan ka ƙaddara mana tsawon rai don tsarkin mulkinka kada ka maimaita mana irin wannan shekarar a rayuwarmu

output.original_text: allah mun tuba allah idan ka ƙaddara mana tsawon rai don tsarkin mulkinka kada ka maimaita mana irin wannan shekarar a rayuwarmu
output.joy: Allah, mu tuba gareka! Idan ka ƙaddara mana tsawon rai don tsarkin mulkinka, muna fatan kada ka maimaita mana irin wannan shekarar a rayuwarmu!
output.sadness: Allah, muna tuba gareka cikin nadama. Idan ka ƙaddara mana tsawon rai don tsarkin mulkinka, da fatan kar ka maimaita mana irin wannan shekarar a rayuwarmu.
output.fear: Allah, muna tuba gareka a cikin damuwa. Idan ka ƙaddara mana tsawon rai don tsarkin mulkinka, muna fatan kada ka maimaita mana irin wannan shekarar a rayuwarmu.
output.anger: Allah, muna tuba gareka! Idan ka ƙaddara mana tsawon rai don tsarkin mulkinka, kada ka maimaita mana irin wannan shekarar a rayuwarmu, saboda ba mu yarda da wannan ba!
output.surprise: Allah, mu tuba gareka! Idan ka ƙaddara mana tsawon rai don tsarkin mulkinka, muna mamakin ku, don kada ka maimaita mana irin wannan shekarar a rayuwarmu!
output.disgust: Allah, muna tuba gareka da ƙyaƙƙiya. Idan ka ƙaddara mana tsawon rai don tsarkin mulkinka, kada ka maimaita mana irin wannan shekarar a rayuwarmu; ba mu son irin wannan ba!
